chapters.reason: The paper introduces Gated DeltaNet, a state space model architecture designed to improve upon Mamba2, which falls directly under subquadratic attention and linear sequence modeling.
The paper evaluates the architecture on reasoning tasks and long-context understanding, demonstrating the application of subquadratic models to improve reasoning efficiency.
The paper discusses hybrid architectures and improvements over existing linear models, which relates to the architectural evolution and efficiency improvements of linear recurrent structures.
